note: State historic site at the south edge of Ranchester: a grassy, cottonwood-shaded loop inside an oxbow of the Tongue River, a few blocks from town. Playground and horseshoe pits; the camping and picnic sites are shared. Fees paid on site, cash or check. Closed for a while in early summer 2025 and reopened July 1. --Claude
summary: Captured Connor Battlefield page (2026-10-12): 20 camping/picnic sites, first-come, dry camping, open April (weather permitting) to Oct 31. Waterfront riverfront -> creekside: the Tongue River here is ~23-26 m wide on imagery; sites along the north loop and east spur road sit ~10-25 m from it over open lawn. Pin ~395 m SW at a county-road bend outside the campground -> move to 44.9055,-107.1628. Phone empty -> 307-684-7629.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> creekside: measured on a 280-m Esri frame, the Tongue River channel around the oxbow is ~23-26 m wide (north bend ~26 m, west side ~23 m, east side ~20-25 m) - under the ~30 m riverfront threshold. The campground loop runs along the north and east sides of the oxbow on open mown lawn with scattered cottonwoods, with sites ~10-25 m from the water (north loop around 44.9060,-107.1630; east spur road around 44.9054,-107.1612). Site numbers are not published (first-come, no booking map); all are sold by the night.

PIN MOVE (~395 m): stored 44.90291,-107.16623 is on County Road 67 at a field bend south of a different (wooded, roadless) oxbow. The campground loop is the oxbow just south of Ranchester's streets, centred about 44.9055,-107.1628. Stored waterfront_evidence also cites 44.9030,-107.1648 (the wrong oxbow) - suggested replacement: 'Esri imagery at 44.9055,-107.1628: loop road on open lawn inside a Tongue River oxbow, sites ~10-25 m from a ~23-26 m wide channel -> creekside'.

Hookups/booking/fees unchanged (page: 'Dry camping only: no electric, water, or sewer hookups'; 'first-come, first-served basis, without reservations'; fees provenance is manual, not touched). No rig length published; 'travel trailers' are allowed and the loop is open lawn (no rig-length warning).
